correction: A stock 1000MHz characterization constraint is not an application timing-closure gate. Previous reporting treated the expected warnings too strongly as unresolved timing failures. Original native reports remain unchanged.

handbook.section: 9.1.1 Synthesize Your RTL IP Core with Quartus Prime Software
handbook.quote: You can expect to see timing closure warnings in the Quartus® Prime logs because the generated project targets a clock speed of 1000 MHz to achieve the best possible placement for your design. The fMAX value presented in the FPGA Optimization Report estimates the maximum clock rate your component can cleanly close timing for.
